scope: Managed color-component spill storage during PDF mesh construction and sampling
implementation: For more than four components, reserve a conservative power-of-two capacity bound including overlap during SmallVec growth. Generated patch arrays admit three vertex color buffers per triangle plus bounded two-row generation scratch. Triangle sampling admits transformed vertex clones and one interpolation buffer. Sample table growth includes per-bucket stored color spill capacity, retained until the map drops. Inline RGB/RGBA components add no spill reservation.
verified: Nine-component stored sample arrays actually spill to heap and are covered together with measured table allocation_size.
Managed sampling preserves every coverage and component bit relative to sampling without a memory limit.
Refusal at each admission checkpoint releases all previously retained scratch and table credit.
Dropping the completed map releases all retained credit.
limitations: Admission is conservative; component-buffer allocator capacity is not charged with byte-exact precision.
The nine-component qualification is synthetic mesh sampling, not full camera or real PDF DeviceN color qualification.
Function/color-space evaluation temporaries, source parsing, visibility inventory and other renderer allocations still require accounting.
